_note_q2_pool_scaling: Q-2 (TRPG_PARAM_DRIVEN_POOL): names the GENERIC pool-scaling contract for the count_faces 6d4 pool. The engine reads `pool_scaling_parameter` off the INITIATING actor's sheet (no ruleset Rust): the chargen compiler compiles the categorical `competency` CHOICE into a numeric `competency_rank` (ordinal of the chosen option in the ruleset's enumerated competency list -- data-sourced, not a per-label constant). pool_base=6 keeps the flat-baseline (rank 0 -> 6d4) so OFF is byte-identical; pool_per_rank=1 -> a more-competent agent draws on more Agency dice. Shallow-merged into the parsed dice_core (dice/compare/target_face preserved). When the flag is OFF, or no competency_rank is on the sheet, the pool stays a flat 6d4.
